$comment: Components that get a live props playground. Controls are derived from each owner's props metadata (src/generated/catalogue.json); entries here only correct or seed it. values: initial prop values (emitted in the code). options: replace a prop's literal options when the metadata type is wrong. types: force a control type (text, number, boolean). hide: props that get no control. noDefault: props whose metadata default is unreliable (shown as 'Default' instead). range: [min, max, step] renders a number as a slider. Read by scripts/generate.mjs (component loaders) and catalogue-blocks.tsx.
